text:
I am a passionate and creative student looking to learning all I can about the field of Data Science and use my out-of-the-box and artistic thinking to efficiently solve problems. I am majoring in Data Science and Art History at UNC Chapel Hill to earn a well rounded education incorporating both STEM and Humanities fields. I enjoy solving analytical problems, reading, and sewing. I love to combine creative skills I have with how I present data and learn from it, able to utilize both fields in interesting ways to do my best work.
